name: HoldSpin
_intent: Forehand / discus ready pose (seen from the chase camera behind): the flat food held LEVEL out to the RIGHT at shoulder height in the right hand, gripped at its edge, arm out and cocked back so the disc sits clear of the body silhouette; chest coiled a little right, left arm forward for balance, weight on the back (right) foot, a slow sway.
_reference: frisbee forehand / discus wind-up; 2.0 s loop
